title: Remote equipment: design the exception path

slides.headline: What condition deserves attention now?
slides.body: Start with decisions—not dashboards or data volume.

slides.headline: What can wait?
slides.body: Routine telemetry may retry or batch. Exceptions may need another path.

slides.headline: What should the device do locally?
slides.body: Connectivity cannot replace safe local control and fault handling.

slides.headline: How will operations read the state?
slides.body: Make delayed data, loss of link and genuine incidents distinguishable.

slides.headline: Review the exception path
slides.body: Scope the architecture before the next remote failure or truck roll.
